title: Member-Owner Discount on the Rural Home Loans Escrow Waiver Fee
content:
**Cooperative benefit.** Member-owners of the association earn a discount on the Rural Home Loans escrow waiver fee, decided from the member's Member Equities & Patronage records.

## Discount

A member-owner discount applies: a member whose Class B Voting Stock is active and who was paid cash patronage in the 15 months up to today has 30 percent taken off; a member whose Class B Voting Stock is active but who was paid no cash patronage in those months has 15 percent taken off; any other member has no discount. The discount is taken off once, as a percentage of the fee figured at the fee rate on the amount the fee is figured on, before any other amount is taken off.

## Records read on the Member Equities & Patronage side

- The member's Class B Voting Stock holding and whether its status is active.
- Cash patronage payments booked to the member from the day after the same calendar day 15 months before today through today.

## Truth table

| Class B Voting Stock active | Cash patronage paid in the 15 months | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 30 percent |
| yes | no | 15 percent |
| no, or no Class B Voting Stock | — | none |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

A fee figure of 950.00 for a member with active Class B Voting Stock and a cash patronage check 13 months ago: 30 percent off leaves 665.00. Last cash patronage 16 months ago: outside the 15 months, so 15 percent off leaves 807.50. A member holding only a Class C Participation Certificate: no discount.
